Dydra · rdf-replication

The JavaScript API

A client library for reading and writing RDF over the Dydra protocols from a browser or from Node: an RDF/JS environment, the Graph Store and SPARQL interfaces, and a local graph database.

Generated from the library sources by JSDoc 3.5.5 on 12 February 2019, and restyled since; the text is as it stood then.

classes

Classes

  • 01 BlankNodeA BlankNode is a Node which is identified local to a Surface by a string label.
  • 02 CommitRequest
  • 03 DeleteRequest
  • 04 GDBObjectStore
  • 05 GDBTransactionManage a transaction over an ObjectStore collection
  • 06 GetRequest
  • 07 GraphThe class Graph encapsulates a statement sequence with a location url, to augment Triple content, and a base IRI to extend relative IRI to absolute.
  • 08 GraphDatabasea GraphDatabase provides the base implementation for object replication to a remote store. It follows the pattern exemplified by an IndexedDB database (IDBDatabase), but adds logic to support state replication to a graph store
  • 09 GraphEnvironmentThe abstract GraphEnvironment class defines the interface to graphs and their elements.
  • 10 GraphObjectThe abstract root class for all managed objects
  • 11 GraphRequestCombine the object store context and the transaction active at the point when an operation was performed to return to the calling application as a handle. As the operation progresses, include the patch which serves as the intermediate result.
  • 12 GraphStateErrorEncapsulate an error due to an invalid operation.
  • 13 GSPThe GSP class comprises the interface operators for the Graph Store Protocol
  • 14 LangStringThe class LangString specializes Literal for thos strings with language tag.
  • 15 LiteralThe class Literal represents an RDF literal. The specializations LangString and SimpleString provide for cases where a language tag or no datatyoe is provided
  • 16 NamedNodeThe class NamedNode comprises data which represents IRI.
  • 17 NodeThe abstract class Node comprises those values which can be subject, object or context in an RDF Quad.
  • 18 PatchThe class Patch encapsulates delete, post and put constituents. Each is provided as a Graph or graph designator. As the latter a statement sequence is wrapped as Graph while a string is decoded.
  • 19 PostRequest
  • 20 PutRequest
  • 21 QuadThe class Quad specializes Statement for those with subject, predicate, object, and graph terms.
  • 22 RDFDatabase
  • 23 RDFEnvironmentThe class RDFEnvironment specializes the model creation functions and codecs for RDF. An environment instance provides model element creation operations in a mode which provides defaults from environment properties
  • 24 SimpleStringThe class SimpleString specializes Literal for those strings without a language tag.
  • 25 SPARQLThe SPARQL class comprises the interface operators for the SPARQL Protocol
  • 26 StatementThe abstract class Statement comprises Triple and Quad speciaizations
  • 27 TermThe abstract class Term is the root for RDF Terms ">www.w3.org/TR/rdf11-concepts/#section-rdf-graph}
  • 28 TripleThe class Triple specializes Statement for those with just subject, predicate, and object terms.
  • 29 UUIDThe class UUID represented universally unique identifiers as the hex-encoded string.
